question: Which of the following periods in India is also associated with the Iron Age?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Later Vedic Age**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Later Vedic Age** is closely associated with the beginning of the **Iron Age** in India.
 
• This period is marked by the extensive use of **iron tools and weapons**, which led to significant advancements in agriculture, warfare, and other technologies.
 
• The Later Vedic period roughly spans from **1000 BCE to 600 BCE**.
